items.text: $QFIN +4% after a Q3 beat: adjusted EPS $0.51 per ADS vs $0.46 expected, even as revenue fell 37% from a year ago.
$ALVO -10%: a US court temporarily blocked the launch of its biosimilar AVT05 in a patent fight with J&J's Janssen; Q3 revenue also missed. The company will appeal.
AI cloud renters bounce hardest: $NBIS +9.5%, $CRWV +7.9% premarket.
$MRVL +7.3% premarket after beating fiscal Q3 expectations. The stock had lost about 43% over the past month.
$VRTX -7.3% premarket: the FDA extended its review of kidney drug povetacicept by up to three months; the decision is now due by Feb. 28, 2027 instead of Nov. 30.
Chip stocks lead the premarket rebound: $AMD +7%, $MU +6%, $NVDA +4.7%, $AVGO +4.7%, $INTC +4.5%. $NVDA is still more than 37% below its October record.
Nasdaq 100 futures +2.5%, S&P 500 +1.9%, Dow +1.4% as Wall Street returns from Thanksgiving for a half-day session that closes at 1 p.m. ET.
Oil climbs near monthly highs on supply worries: WTI +2.6% to $85.80, Brent $97.27.
